title: Can I disable RPG Maker MZ from automatically leveling up characters?

posts.author: BurdyWurdy
posts.body: Seeking a way to prevent players from automatically leveling up.Trying to design a gameplay loop where experience points will instead be spent at an NPC who levels them up manually if they have the required amount to do so. Can this be done through events, or will I need a plug-in?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
